title: HTTPMiddleware
description: An HTTP middleware that modifies requests or responses.

name.description: The name of the middleware in name@provider format.

type.description: The type of middleware (e.g., addPrefix, basicAuth, buffering, chain, circuitBreaker, compress, headers, ipAllowList, rateLimit, redirectScheme, replacePath, retry, stripPrefix).

status.description: The current status of the middleware.

provider.description: The configuration provider that created this middleware.
